a: A `quatrefoil` badge's `samples` has no upper bound, so `samples: Infinity` hangs the render
A `beavis` badge's `points` skips `repeatCount`, so an infinite or NaN count draws NaN spikes
A `receipt` badge's `tearDepth` has no upper bound, so deep tears cross the opposite edge
A `house` badge's `peakHeight` has no upper bound, so the roof rises past the box and its top inset
b: Composed shapes' declared `insets` are never read, so House, Coffin and Hexagon labels get the polygon base's 0/4/0/4 padding instead of their tuned values
NaN in a continuous shape param reaches the drawn path, while repeat counts map NaN to their minimum
`SHAPES` is a plain object, so a runtime shape name like `"constructor"` resolves through Object.prototype instead of falling back to pill
Beavis `cornerRadius` is in CSS px, but it reaches the base as a fraction of a fixed 22px height, so the drawn radius scales with badge height
Receipt `tearDepth` has no upper bound, so deep tears cross the badge and self-intersect the outline
